title: Choose the Riggs HD visual world
question: Pick the design world for the rebuild, choose a strong alternate, or ask for a fresh hand.

options.label: Locker Room → Lecture Hall
options.lineage: gym thresholds, athlete pathway boards, and college advising folders
options.thesis: One physical path carries a student from sport into relationship, guidance, opportunity, and future.
options.viewport: A real gym photograph opens on the left; a court line crosses a central threshold into a structured future-path dossier on the right.
options.risk: The gym-to-campus transition must feel like one lived journey, not a literal before-and-after collage.

raised.raise: Each stage owns one bounded room, and saturated color appears only at the active decision.
The pathway visibly matures across stages instead of functioning as a decorative arrow.
Display type and microtype use uncompromising scale contrast so the story reads in seconds.
Court and advising geometry repeat as whole units and lock cleanly at every breakpoint.

options.label: Sideline-to-Study-Hall Field Guide
options.lineage: coach playbooks, scouting notes, and student advising workbooks
options.thesis: The site becomes the field guide a young athlete carries from first drill to first opportunity.
options.viewport: A large real team photograph is annotated like a working playbook, while one folded guide edge reveals the five-stage future pathway.
options.risk: It is the most familiar direction for this exact sports-plus-advising story and could become predictable if the document craft is weak.

options.label: Future Departures Board
options.lineage: rail-concourse split-flap boards and fixed-cell status systems
options.thesis: Programs and next steps become a live departures board for futures already in motion.
options.viewport: The five-stage pathway fills a black split-flap board above a real gym concourse image, with current program statuses in fixed columns.
options.case: It matches program and event clarity exceptionally well, but its transit language is less emotionally native to students and families.
options.risk: Too much mechanical motion or black density could make a youth nonprofit feel cold.

options.label: Game Film Viewfinder
options.lineage: camcorder viewfinders, game-film review, and focus brackets
options.thesis: Real program moments stay full-bleed while the interface focuses each next decision in a young person's story.
options.viewport: The program reel fills the frame; focus brackets settle on students and reveal the pathway, programs, and next action as viewfinder readouts.
options.case: It gives the real media urgency and youth recognition, but it is less natural for long-form program and donation information.
options.risk: The interface could feel like a film product instead of a trusted community organization.

options.label: Colorfield Guidance Wall
options.thesis: The mission is arranged as transparent rooms of sport, guidance, and future opportunity.
options.viewport: A wall of photographic panes lights one mission stage at a time.
options.case: It loses audience identification and makes the nonprofit mechanism less immediately legible.
options.risk: The architectural metaphor can overpower the people and programs.
options.kept: One room, one statement, one color-coded state.

options.label: Seasonal Growth Calendar
options.lineage: dated preservation labels and seasonal maturation records
options.thesis: Youth development becomes a visible record of growth over time.
options.viewport: The five-stage pathway appears as a seasonal shelf of dated growth records.
options.case: The maturation idea is useful, but the food-world carrier has no credible connection to the audience.
options.risk: It would read whimsical where the organization needs trust.
options.kept: Progress must visibly mature from stage to stage.

options.label: Future Type Specimen
options.thesis: A young person's future expands from one name into many possible forms.
options.viewport: The word FUTURE transforms at giant scale above a strict grid of program proof.
options.case: The type can dramatize possibility, but it identifies neither the basketball entry point nor the service model clearly enough.
options.risk: The system can become a designer showcase instead of a youth-serving organization.
options.kept: Hierarchy is carried by fearless scale contrast, not extra decoration.

options.label: Community Pattern Manual
options.lineage: regional ornament plate books and repeatable geometric units
options.thesis: Court lines and educational symbols assemble into one community-owned visual alphabet.
options.viewport: A numbered plate of symbols assembles into the Riggs HD pathway around real program photography.
options.case: It can create a durable identity system, but it delays the simple human story visitors need first.
options.risk: The pattern language can feel institutional and distant from real youth.
options.kept: Geometry repeats in whole units and locks at responsive boundaries.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished youth-sports nonprofit site with a full-bleed hero, program tiles, impact metrics, and a prominent donation action.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional photography hero states the mission with Programs and Donate buttons above a three-card program row.
canonCard.risk: It will be familiar and usable, but visually interchangeable with many youth-sports nonprofits.
